name: state-saver
title: State Saver
description:
State Saver lets you capture your entire workspace with a single command — open apps, browser tabs, code editors, and terminal sessions — and restore them instantly whenever you need.

Whether you’re switching between projects, resuming after a break, or managing multiple workflows, ContextSync keeps your context intact so you can focus on what matters: doing your work, not setting it up.
author: ben_aguirre

commands.name: save-current-snapshot
commands.title: Save State
commands.subtitle: Saves the current state of your computer
commands.description: Saves the current state of your computer enabling you to save it and be used later (opening everything you need)

commands.name: open-snapshot
commands.title: Open Snapshot
commands.subtitle: Restore a saved state snapshot
commands.description: Select and restore Chrome tabs from a saved snapshot

commands.name: view-snapshots
commands.title: View Snapshots
commands.subtitle: View all saved state snapshots
commands.description: Display and manage all saved state snapshots with their details
